name: enterprise-page
title: Enterprise page
description: The site's enterprise page from library items: the header, the hero inside its ring of creatives, the logo row, the automation run under its quote, the eight features and the close with two buttons, then the footer.
use_for: An enterprise or sales page; `content` replaces the copy, and `cards`, `logos`, `run` and `features` take your creatives and marks.
never: Customer logos, quotes or creatives you may not show: the defaults are Acme placeholders
A second White button in a section
The connect menu in the close: this page closes on a demo
source: Site app/enterprise and pages/Enterprise (EnterprisePage.tsx, Enterprise.module.css, LogoStrip.module.css) and content/pages/enterprise.ts: hero, logos (--ent-logos-above 24px, 16 from 768; --section-y below), AutomationRun, FeatureGrid, PageClose with two buttons and no texture
body:
`sections` lists the sections to show, in order (`hero`, `proof`, `run`, `features`, `close`); a key left out is not
shown. `cards`, `run` and `features` carry the pictures (image slots: `src`, `alt`, `fit`, `position`). `menus` passes
the header menus (the live card's `picture`, the use cases' `shots`).

import '@/elements/components/site/page-close' import '@/elements/components/blocks/site-footer' import styles from 'virtual:tw' import { pageSections } from '@/lib/image' import { headerMenus, type HeaderMenus } from '@/lib/site-header' // EnterprisePage.tsx as : the header, the hero in its ring, the logo row, the automation run, // the eight features, the close with two buttons and the footer. `content`, `cards`, `logos`, `run` and `features` (JSON). /** * @summary The enterprise page. */ export class EnterprisePage extends DsElement { static styles = [DsElement.styles, styles] protected readonly layout = new HostLayoutController(this, () => this.renderRoot.querySelector('[data-ds="enterprise-page"]')) static properties = { content: { type: Object }, cards: { type: Array }, logos: { type: Array }, run: { type: Array }, features: { type: Object }, menus: { type: Object }, sections: { type: Array } } /** The copy (lib/pages/enterprise.ts by default). */ content: EnterprisePageContent = enterprisePageContent /** The hero ring's sets of creatives. */ cards: RingCard[][] = ringPlaceholders /** The logo row's marks. */ logos: ProofLogo[] = proofPlaceholders /** The automation run's batch. */ run: RunItem[] = runPlaceholders /** The features' copy, data and pictures. */ features: EnterpriseFeaturesContent = enterpriseFeaturesContent /** The header menus' order by default. */ sections?: EnterpriseSection[] render() { const c = this.content ?? enterprisePageContent const wrap = 'mx-auto w-full max-w-[calc(var(--ds-layout-content)+2*var(--ds-layout-gutter))] px-(--ds-layout-gutter)' const parts: Record = { hero: html``, proof: html`
`, run: html``, features: html``, close: html``, } return html`
